exposure: cesarean section before onset of labor
cohort: 33 women with previous cesarean section and pathologically confirmed AWE, and 127 controls with previous cesarean section and no AWE
finding: Cesarean section before the onset of labor is the most significant risk factor for developing abdominal wall endometriosis, although high antenatal BMI, weight gain during pregnancy, and longer procedure duration also contribute.
mod_finding: Cesarean section before the onset of labor is the most significant risk factor for developing abdominal wall endometriosis.
